text.aria-label: Title text 'Low winds: the upper quantiles against the observed power'

g.text: Low winds: the upper quantiles against the observed power

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Black band and thin line: observed median and 5% to 95% band in bins of ERA5 speed at the valid time. Thick black: observed 95% (solid) and 99% (dashed) quantiles of power in bins of the ensemble-mean speed at forecast time. Coloured: each arm's mean forecast q95 (solid) and q99 (dashed) in the same forecast-speed bins. Grey dotted: cut-in; grey dashed: rated; blue band: experiment 210 idle band. Scored year, all half-hours, 1 to 10 days. W1 to W3 are anonymised farms; the last panel pools them.'
text.tspan: Black band and thin line: observed median and 5% to 95% band in bins of ERA5
speed at the valid time. Thick black: observed 95% (solid) and 99% (dashed)
quantiles of power in bins of the ensemble-mean speed at forecast time.
Coloured: each arm's mean forecast q95 (solid) and q99 (dashed) in the same
forecast-speed bins. Grey dotted: cut-in; grey dashed: rated; blue band:
experiment 210 idle band. Scored year, all half-hours, 1 to 10 days. W1 to W3
are anonymised farms; the last panel pools them.
